newsitem.title: UK: Left-winger Short gets British cabinet post.
newsitem.headline: Left-winger Short gets British cabinet post.

text.p: Labour left-winger Clare Short said on Saturday she had been given a cabinet post in Prime Minister Tony Blair's new British government.

Short, an outspoken member of Blair's modernised Labour Party, told reporters she had been given the post of minister for Overseas Development. There had been speculation that the moderate Blair might leave her out of the cabinet.
